svg.title: PRL architecture
svg.desc: A completed sandbox rollout enters your function fn(traj), then framework mapping, then the policy update. The function reads task, reward, reasoning, commands and terminal output. Reweight, Rewrite and Reroll become token loss masks, advantage factors and new samples. GRPO, PPO or REINFORCE++ computes advantages and updates the policy. Dashed branches show an optional ask call to a teacher or judge and rerolling a chosen prefix in fresh sandboxes.

g.aria-label: Optional ask: transform to teacher or judge
Reroll: transform back to sandbox rollout
